row.feeTitle: Evidenced fee linked to this invoice/bill
row.notMatchedTitle: No invoice linked — link it on the Invoices page
row.onStatementTitle: Matched to a bank statement line

rowActions.confirmDelete: Delete this entry? A transfer's other side or a withheld bank fee is deleted with it.

postThrough.label: Post reviewed entries through
postThrough.confirm: Post all reviewed entries up to {date}? They'll be locked — fix them later by reversing.
postThrough.done: {count, plural, one {# entry posted} other {# entries posted}}

status.draft: Draft — waiting for review. Not in balances or reports yet.
status.reviewed: Reviewed — counted in balances and reports.
status.posted: Posted — locked. Evidence and tax review can still change.
status.confirmPost: Post this entry? It will be locked — fix it later by reversing.
status.rejected: Rejected — fix it and save to send it back for review.
status.rejectedOwner: Rejected — not counted. It comes back to you once corrected, or approve it now.

reverse.title: Reverse a posted entry
reverse.body: A reversal cancels this entry in full. Both stay on record; you enter the correction next.
reverse.withFee: The withheld bank fee is reversed too. The invoice reopens — record the payment again there.

history.title: History
history.empty: No changes yet (history kept since 4 Oct 2026).

form.fromBankLine: From bank line {label} — matched when you save.
form.fromCostItem: From the cost register: {label} — saved with its receipt.
form.correcting: Correcting reversed entry {label} — enter the right values.
form.accountHint: Bank, company cash, or Owner-paid if you paid it personally.
form.rateBankHint: Most accurate — taken from the bank statement.
form.rateManualHint: Use the rate on the receipt or the bank's rate for that day.
form.rateDefaultHint: Only an estimate — switch to the bank figure when you have the statement.
form.fileTypes: PNG, JPG, PDF, ZIP (e.g. original e-invoice) — up to 10 MB per save
form.ownerDecides: The owner sets purpose, CIT and VAT after review.

errors.amountDate: Enter a valid amount and date.
errors.usdAccount: {name} is a USD account — enter the amount in USD.
errors.registerItemExpense: A cost register item can only be saved as an expense.
errors.correctionNeedsReversal: Only a reversed entry can be re-entered as a correction.
errors.registerItemTaken: That register item is already in the ledger or dismissed.
errors.editOnAccounts: Edit transfers, capital and loans on the Accounts page.
errors.reversedLocked: A reversed entry and its reversal can't change.
errors.settlesInvoice: This entry settles an invoice — unlink it on the Invoices page before changing its amount, currency or type.
errors.bankLineMatched: This entry is matched to a bank statement line. {problem} Unmatch it on the Bank page first.
errors.postThroughDate: Choose the date to post through.
errors.reasonRequired: Give the reason for the correction.
errors.onlyPostedReversed: Only posted entries are reversed — change drafts and reviewed entries directly.
errors.alreadyReversed: This entry has already been reversed.
errors.attachmentPosted: This entry is posted — its attachments are kept.
errors.attachmentCostItem: This receipt belongs to a cost register item — it stays with the expense.
errors.attachmentFeeEvidence: This is the evidence for a fee on an invoice — unlink the fee first.
errors.attachmentOwnerOnly: Only the owner can remove this document.
errors.feePairLocked: A withheld bank fee must match its receipt (account, currency, type, date, project). Edit the receipt, or reverse or delete both.
errors.feeExceedsReceipt: The bank fee must stay less than the receipt it was withheld from.
errors.pairNotPosted: Can't reverse yet — its linked entries must all be posted and not reversed.
errors.rejectReasonRequired: Give the reason for rejecting it.
errors.onlyDraftsRejected: Only drafts waiting for review can be rejected.
errors.postedMeanwhile: This entry was posted meanwhile — reload. To change it, reverse it.

revalue.withFee: Includes the withheld bank fee ({fee}), revalued together.
revalue.keptHint: Editing keeps this value. Use Revalue to change it.
revalue.adminOnly: Editing keeps this value. Only an admin can revalue it.
revalue.feeHint: A fee withheld from a receipt is revalued with its receipt.
revalue.transferHint: A transfer keeps the rate its two sides imply.
revalue.netPlaceholder: VND the bank credited (net of the fee)

errors.vnd: A VND entry has no exchange rate to revalue.
errors.posted: This entry is posted — reverse it and enter the correction instead.
errors.transfer: A transfer keeps the rate its two sides imply — edit the transfer instead.
errors.fee: Revalue the receipt this fee was withheld from — the fee follows it.
errors.unchanged: That gives the same VND value — nothing to revalue.
errors.enterValue: Enter the new rate or VND amount.
errors.matched: Matched to a bank line in another currency — unmatch it, revalue, then match again.

revalue.postedHint: Posted — locked. To change it, reverse the entry.
revalue.reversedHint: Locked: a reversed entry and its reversal keep this value.

reject.title: Reject this entry
reject.body: It goes back to whoever entered it, with your reason. Once they fix and save it, it returns for your review.
reject.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. wrong account — this was paid from MB USD

status.posted: To change anything else, reverse it, then enter the correction.

reverse.body: Its bank match and invoice links are removed — match and link the correction instead.

form.reviewHintExpense: Recording an expense doesn't make it deductible or its VAT claimable. Each stays pending until reviewed.
form.reviewHintIncome: Receiving money doesn't mean an invoice was issued.
